question_text: You are given house_sort(entries), which returns the non-None House objects in ascending price order. Construct select_three(entries, budget) in Python. Return the three highest-priced objects costing no more than budget, in ascending price order. At least three eligible objects exist. Use the supplied helper.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.

marking_points.criterion: Selects the last three eligible objects.
Returns those objects in ascending order.
